card.name: Time units after small numbers
card.fires_on: The unit word (usually weeks) right after a small number like 2, 3 or 4 in dosing schedules, such as every 4 weeks. Also fires on the last digit of a day in man-page dates.

modes.label: Weeks after a number
modes.description: The word weeks or a minute unit directly after a small number in a dosing or retest interval.

modes.label: Man-page date digits
modes.description: The final digit of the day in a date line at the end of a Linux man page.

card.plain: It marks the time unit after a small number when a label says how often to give or recheck something.
